item.title: SCMP: David vs Goliaths: Singapore builds most accurate clock ever, leaves US and China in dust
item.description: A small Singaporean research team has beaten scientists in China and the United States to build the world’s most accurate atomic clock. The clock, built with a single ion of a rare earth metal element known as lutetium, is so precise that it would lose one second every 260 billion years – nearly 20 times the age of our universe.
